headline: Read a contract properly in ten minutes
prompt: Read the attached document. Do not summarise it. Give me the ten questions a careful [your role] should ask before agreeing to it, in order of how much money or risk each one carries. For each, quote the clause or page it comes from so I can check it, and say in one line why it matters. Then list anything you expected to find and did not.
attach: the contract, tender or policy as a file. Works in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot.
